answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain influence. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed endorsements; freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus thresholds. Like pigment mapped in an atlas at a jetty, trust must accumulate through verifiable history, not a fresh name.
